notes.title: Patch Notes for August 2nd
notes.content:
- Added additional enemies to sandbox mode. You can now select one, two, or three enemies to fight against.
- Lowered size increase of units upon receiving a kill.
- AI behavior improvements.
- New options for sandbox mode: enemy gold generation, starting bonus health/armor/damage for enemy warlords.
- Nerfed upgrades: Valiant Armor/Health.
- Nerfed upgrades: For My Lord's Damage/Armor/Health/MoveSpeed.
- Nerfed upgrades: Vengeful Pig/Raise The Dead/Reanimate Corpse.
- Nerfed upgrade: Hamstring.
- Buffed upgrade: Initiative.
- Buffed upgrade: Sunder.
- Buffed upgrade: Last Stand.
